title: Project Staffing
prompt:
Assign specialists A through I to projects X, Y, and Z. Each specialist must be assigned exactly once, and each project must receive exactly three specialists.

Eligibility:
- A: X or Y
- B: X or Z
- C: Y or Z
- D, E, F, G, H, I: X, Y, or Z

Coverage requirements:
- X must contain at least one of A, D, G.
- Y must contain at least one of C, E, H.
- Z must contain at least one of B, F, I.

Relationship rules:
- D and H must be assigned to the same project.
- E and G must be assigned to different projects.
- F and I must be assigned to different projects.
- A and B must be assigned to different projects.

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"assignments":{"A":"X","B":"Z", ...}}}
Include exactly one project for every specialist A-I. Any valid allocation is accepted.
